name: Taipei Songshan Airport

runway.v: one runway, 10/28, 2,605 m long and 60 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration 05:00 to 23:00 local time (2100-1500 UTC)

curfew.v: no civil take-offs or landings from 23:00 to 06:00 local time (1500-2200 UTC), except emergencies
curfew.quote: Curfew period: 1500-2200 UTC daily. Except for emergency, take-off or landings of civil aircraft are prohibited.

hours.v: aerodrome administration 06:00 to 23:00 local time (2200-1500 UTC)

handling.v: passengers and crew of international business charter or private aircraft clear customs at the Business Aviation center
handling.quote: Passengers and flight crew of international business charter or private aircraft departing or landing Taipei/Songshan Airport

noise.v: noise abatement departure procedures apply 23:00 to 06:00 local time

missing: iata (AIP page does not state it)
notes: Times converted from UTC to Taiwan time (UTC+8, no daylight saving).
